title: Lazar pushed out by intelligence after John Lear gave files to George Knapp, around the time of Majestic 12

I think this guy John Lear, who was CIA affiliated Right. pushed him out to George Knapp.
tellings.difference: Calls Lear CIA-affiliated and frames Lazar as a limited hangout.
tellings.link_reason: Same theory: intelligence pushed Lazar out through John Lear, who passed things to George Knapp.

as_told.title: Lazar as limited hangout pushed out via John Lear

related.note: Both explain how Lazar's S-4 story got out as an intelligence move around 1988-89. The story says Lazar was pushed out after Lear gave files to Knapp; this telling says the leak was a planned release through someone with a poor reputation. These are competing core claims about the same event.

plain: Michels thinks Bob Lazar, a man who claimed to have worked on recovered alien craft in the late 1980s, was pushed out into the public by intelligence agencies. He says this happened after John Lear, a pilot and UFO researcher, gave files to George Knapp, a Las Vegas TV journalist, around the time of the MJ-12 documents (papers claiming that a secret committee called Majestic 12 handled crashed saucers). Michels says this as his own guess on two episodes. The second time he calls Lear "CIA affiliated" and treats Lazar as a "limited hangout," meaning a partial truth released on purpose to steer attention.
